roadmap.title: From prompts to content production.
roadmap.intro: The vision for Framix is a creative workspace using AI to edit footage and generate new assets. The capabilities below are not available in the current demo.
roadmap.f0Body: AI would identify useful moments in long videos and create short edits, reframing, and captions. Creators would review the results.
roadmap.f1Body: Create draft video scenes from prompts or references, then combine them with footage on the timeline.
roadmap.f2Body: Turn briefs into animated text, titles, transitions, and graphic elements that can be revised.
roadmap.f3Body: Explore product visuals, backgrounds, and compositions from reference photos for campaigns.
roadmap.f4Body: Develop concepts, scripts, and drafts of UGC-style product content with checks for claims and asset rights.
roadmap.f5Body: Connect briefs, asset generation, editing, revisions, and export. Models, providers, costs, and availability will be determined during development.
roadmap.note: A roadmap, not released features. Video and image generation, motion graphics, UGC, and auto clipping are not included in the demo. Generative workflows will require AI services and creator review; access and pricing are not set.

install.intro: Install Kebun Pintar: Letters & Numbers using the official APK. This guide is for parents and caregivers.
install.pending: The APK download is being prepared. Contact us for Android availability.
install.notPlayStore: Kebun Pintar: Letters & Numbers is not yet on Google Play. Install it directly using the APK file.
install.offline: Content and audio work offline during the trial or after activation.
install.step1Title: Download the APK from this page
install.step1Description: Open this page on your Android phone, select Download Android APK, and wait for it to finish. Check the filename and version shown here.
install.step2Description: Open Downloads in Chrome or the Files/My Files app. Tap the KebunPintar file ending in .apk.
install.step3Title: Allow the source app if prompted
install.step3Description: If Android requests permission, open Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps. Select the browser or file manager you used, then enable Allow from this source. Menu names vary by device.
install.step4Description: Return to the APK, select Install, then Open. Allow Google Play Protect to scan the app if requested. Some devices may require additional verification.
install.step5Description: The 24-hour trial starts the first time you open the app. Choose letters or numbers and explore together. Turn off the installation permission for the source app. When the trial expires, open activation and contact our official WhatsApp.
install.safety: Keep Google Play Protect enabled. If the app is blocked or reported as harmful, stop installing and contact us with the message shown.
install.faq1Title: Why does Android say “App not installed”?
install.faq1Description: Check that you have Android 8.0+, an updated Android System WebView, enough storage, and a complete download. Older test APKs may use a different signature and cannot update directly to this release. Contact us before uninstalling: uninstalling deletes local progress.
install.faq2Title: Can I install this APK on an iPhone?
install.faq2Description: No. APK files are for Android only. An iPhone version is not available through this download.
install.faq3Title: How do I update the app?
install.faq3Description: Return here for the latest version and install the official APK over your existing app. Updates require the same app identity and signing key; contact us if Android rejects the update.
install.trialDescription: The trial starts automatically on first launch and continues while the app is closed. After 24 hours, contact our official WhatsApp for purchase information and a device-specific activation code.

legal.label: Privacy information
legal.privacy_desc: How this website uses browser storage and what happens when you contact the developer.
legal.web_body: The website stores your ID/EN language choice in your browser. No additional analytics are installed. The contact form uses FormSubmit; submitted names, email addresses, and messages are processed by that service for delivery to hello@ifuix.com.
legal.hosting_body: GitHub Pages receives requests to display website pages and files. Fuira pages also request public release information from GitHub. Use of these services follows the providers' policies.
legal.contact_body: WhatsApp or email messages are received by Iqbal Fasyah to answer questions and help with the apps. Messages are processed through the service you choose. Do not send passwords, activation codes, or a child's personal data.
legal.app_body: The website and apps have different storage functions. Fuira keeps core data locally and offers user-enabled Google Drive sync. Kebun Pintar has its own privacy page.
legal.kebun_desc: Information for parents about Android APK 3.2.1 available on the IFUIX website.
legal.kebun_scope_body: Kebun Pintar is developed by Iqbal Fasyah under the IFUIX name to introduce letters and numbers to ages 3–6. This page covers APK 3.2.1; development videos and screenshots may show different features.
legal.kebun_local_body: Learning content and audio are bundled with the app. Settings, progress, trial state, and activation use app storage on your device. Clearing app data or uninstalling may delete that local information.
legal.kebun_activation_body: The trial lasts 24 hours from first launch. Purchases and activation codes are discussed with a parent or caregiver through the official IFUIX WhatsApp. This involves parent communication and the device activation identity; do not include a child's personal data. This APK does not use Google Play payments.
legal.kebun_permissions_body: APK 3.2.1 declares no Android permissions. Learning content works offline during the trial or after activation. This version does not request camera, microphone, location, or contacts access.
legal.kebun_control_body: Parents can clear data in Android settings or uninstall the app. Contact the developer before uninstalling if you need help with activation or updates. I do not request a child's name, email, photo, or profile to use the learning content.
legal.questions_body: Contact hello@ifuix.com or the official IFUIX WhatsApp with questions or requests about information you sent to the developer.

presentation.profileBody: I am Iqbal Fasyah, founder and developer of IFUIX, with 10 years of software development experience. IFUIX started as an independent brand from Indonesia in February 2023. I am now moving IFUIX toward software and SaaS with AI at the core of creative and money-management workflows.
presentation.aiTitle: AI at the core of the workflow.
presentation.aiIntro: Framix provides a foundation for creative workflows. IFUIX Finance is our next SaaS concept. Available products and future features are labeled separately.
presentation.ai0Body: Build a draft from talking-head footage or revise a timeline through prompts. Automatic captions assist editing; results become a new project you can edit and review.
presentation.ai1Body: Exploring AI assistance for planning work and understanding notes. Current app features remain focused on notes, schedules, and timers.
presentation.ai2Body: Exploring learning assistance suitable for children and caregivers. The current public APK contains letter and number activities, without an AI assistant.
presentation.aiNote: Framix AI uses a local model to interpret instructions. B-roll selection uses tags on reviewed assets, rather than automatic image understanding. Results still need review. Claude integration remains planned.
presentation.claudeTitle: Next: an editing assistant using Claude
presentation.claudeBody: I plan to use the Claude API to interpret editing requests, transcripts, and project metadata. The assistant would suggest cuts, caption revisions, and editable timeline actions. Users would review the draft before export. This integration is not available yet; Framix currently uses local AI.

finance.name: IFUIX Finance
finance.title: Clearer finances, with AI.
finance.intro: A SaaS concept for freelancers and small businesses that want to understand income, spending, and invoices without organizing everything manually.
finance.note: Working name. The product is not available; the features below are development concepts. No accounts, pricing, or launch date yet.
finance.contact: I am interested in IFUIX Finance
finance.featuresTitle: From transaction records to a clearer business picture.
finance.f0Body: Upload a receipt or invoice. AI would suggest dates, amounts, and categories for you to check before saving.
finance.f1Body: Ask about major expenses or unpaid invoices. Answers would refer to source transactions rather than guessed numbers.
finance.f2Body: AI would summarize income, costs, and changes across periods using data you have confirmed.
finance.flowBody: Import records or documents → AI drafts entries → you correct and approve → dashboards and summaries update.
finance.scopeBody: The initial scope is transactions, invoices, categories, and summaries. Bank connections, payments, investments, and tax filing are outside the initial scope.
finance.privacyBody: The design includes consent for document processing, account data separation, export, and deletion. AI would not move money or save transactions without confirmation. Provider and data-policy details will be established before launch.
